landing.heroDescription: Transform your Software Bill of Materials (JSON or XML) into executive health reports, hierarchical tree views, and 2D dependency graphs without sending any data to external servers.
landing.sec1Desc: The SBOM file is processed exclusively in your browser memory (RAM). No data is sent to the cloud.
landing.sec2Desc: Strict external DTD disabling parser with DFS circular dependency graph protection.
landing.sec3Desc: Instant normalization of thousands of components in milliseconds using high-performance JS/TS algorithms.
landing.valuePropsSubtitle: Holistic visualization of direct and transitive dependencies, license matrix, and CVE vulnerabilities
landing.vp1Title: Executive SCA Health Rating (0-100 & A+ to F)
landing.vp1Desc: Logarithmic score weighted by CVE severity (Critical, High, Medium, Low) and Copyleft license risks.
landing.vp2Desc: Navigate full application topology with automated hierarchical layout and ancestor impact path tracing.
landing.vp3Desc: Explore deep nested dependencies with file tree view, depth level badges, and keyboard shortcuts.
landing.vp4Desc: Filter and sort components by PURL, group, license type (Permissive vs Copyleft), and CVE presence.
landing.vp5Desc: Identify direct dependencies with the highest downstream impact to prioritize high ROI updates.
landing.vp6Desc: Compatible with CycloneDX specification in JSON and XML (versions 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5, and 1.6).
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Generate your CycloneDX file in your pipeline and visualize in seconds
landing.step1Desc: Export your SBOM using cdxgen, Trivy, Syft, or CycloneDX CLI in JSON or XML format.
landing.step2Desc: Drag and drop the .json or .xml file into the dropzone or try one of our built-in samples.
landing.step3Desc: Analyze executive score, 2D dependency graph, license risks, and remediate Quick Wins.
landing.faqSubtitle: Quick answers regarding privacy, supported formats, and risk scoring
landing.faq1Q: Are my SBOM files uploaded to any external server?
landing.faq1A: No. This application runs 100% client-side in your browser. No files or data ever leave your computer.
landing.faq2Q: Which CycloneDX formats and versions are supported?
landing.faq2A: We support CycloneDX in both JSON and XML formats for versions 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5, and 1.6.
landing.faq3Q: How is the SCA Health Rating calculated?
landing.faq3A: We use a weighted logarithmic formula: penalizing CVEs by severity (Critical: 15, High: 6, Medium: 2, Low: 0.5) and restrictive Copyleft (10) or Unknown (2) licenses. The score ranges from 0 to 100 with letter grades A+ to F.
landing.faq4A: They are direct dependencies that pull in the largest number of vulnerable or non-compliant transitive dependencies. Updating or replacing a Quick Win fixes multiple issues at once.
landing.faq5Q: How does the system handle cyclic dependency graphs?
landing.faq5A: Our normalizer uses a visited set (DFS traversal) and strict recursion depth limit (maxDepth = 32) to prevent infinite loops and memory exhaustion on cyclic graphs.
